creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 with restarting an agent in its pane (a_2dmIEdCn6). Only the fake agent has been restarted by that code: nobody has seen a real Claude Code end on SIGTERM inside its grace, leave its shell at a prompt, and come back from the typed resume in the same conversation. A step in ./dev --claude-code would say so on every harness update, and one in ./dev --codex once the OpenAI account is back (2026-11-02), since Codex now resumes without its flags.
title: ./dev --claude-code restarts a real Claude Code and sees it come back resumed
